data.completion_memo: Implemented the single-flight enrollment, activation, rollback, and restart-recovery coordinator. Enrollment only materializes the fixed initial slot. Activation reverifies durable baton, slots, selector, generations, checkpoint, and verification plan; journals every effect intent and exact observation; seals candidate results only from watchdog-produced evidence; deterministically cleans, restores, reverifies, and relaunches the previous generation on failure; and seals bounded manual recovery when automatic proof is absent.
data.description: Implement the helper's single-flight coordinator for fixed nonactivating enrollment, admitted activation, selector switch, candidate verification, deterministic rollback/relaunch, terminal protected receipts, and ManualRecoveryRequired. Drive only the journal, slot, profile, and watchdog ports; expose immutable results through the existing bootstrap protocol. Core handoff and Management UI behavior are owned by M10.3 and M10.4.
data.title: M11.6 — Implement the enrollment, activation, and rollback coordinator
